_description: URL association strategy presets for the Digital Garden browser extension. User overrides take precedence over these defaults. Edit freely — no code changes required, changes take effect on next page load.

_strategies.exact: Domain + full path + query string (hash stripped). Best for articles, Q&A pages, specific unique content.
_strategies.path: Domain + full path, all query params stripped. Best for content sites where params are tracking noise.
_strategies.path-depth: Domain + first N path segments only. Best for hierarchical sites: GitHub (org/repo = depth 2), Reddit (r/community = depth 2).
_strategies.params: Domain + specific named params only. Best when a query param IS the content identifier (YouTube v=, HN id=).
_strategies.domain: Domain only. All pages on the domain share one note. Best for tools and dashboards.
_strategies.ignore: No overlay shown. Best for search engines, email, and ephemeral session-based apps.
